sentences.t: 1, 2, 3, testing. A man falls off a cruise ship. At night, nobody sees it. He hits the water,
and the ship keeps sailing. Wait, what? Nobody noticed? You see, he'd only been on board for a
day. Minutes earlier, he'd won an air guitar contest with his sister. Then he went to the
bathroom. And that's the last thing he remembers. He wakes up alone in the dark water. No boat,
no lights, nothing. So, he treads water. Jellyfish drift by, glowing in the dark,
their tentacles brushing his legs. A strong current drags him farther and farther from
the ship, and every shadow in the water could be a shark. Now imagine something even bigger,
something enormous sliding silently far below him. Dark, massive, gone. The sun comes up,
and he's still swimming. Back on the ship, his sister realizes he never came back. The ship turns
around and retraces its route, but one person in a huge ocean is just a tiny dot. Almost 20
hours later, a cargo ship crew spots a person, still alive. A helicopter lowers a rescuer
and pulls him out. The guy who vanished after winning an air guitar contest
survived almost a day alone in the Gulf of Mexico.
